title: Crossing the road safely
examples: What should I do before I walk into the street?
Where is the safest place to cross the road?
Do I need an adult to cross the road?

explain.say: First, we must always stop before we cross the road.
Next, we need to look left and then look right.
Then, we must listen very carefully for any cars.
We should only cross where there are special crossings.
It is always best to hold an adult’s hand when crossing.
When we cross the road, we must walk slowly and straight.

faq.q: What is the first thing I must do before I cross?
faq.a: You must always stop at the edge of the pavement first. This keeps you safe until you are ready to go.

faq.q: How do I know if it is safe to cross?
faq.a: You need to look left, look right, and then listen for any traffic noises. Only cross when it is clear.
asks: Is it safe to cross now?
What should I check before walking out?

faq.q: Where is the best place to cross the street?
faq.a: The best places are marked crossings like zebra crossings or signal lights. Never cross in the middle of the road.
asks: What are the safe crossing spots?

faq.q: Why should I hold an adult's hand?
faq.a: Holding an adult's hand keeps you close and safe from cars. Grown-ups know the rules very well.

faq.q: What if I hear a car coming?
faq.a: If you hear a car, you must stop immediately and wait quietly. Do not start walking until it is completely safe.
asks: What do I do if I hear a noise?

facts: Always stop at the curb before crossing.
Look left, look right, and look left again.
Use designated crossings like zebra stripes.
Hold a grown-up's hand for extra safety.

quiz.why: You must stop first to check your surroundings safely.

wrong.0: Holding hands is good, but you must stop first.
wrong.2: Looking is important, but stopping comes before looking.
wrong.3: Listening is part of it, but stopping is the very first step.

quiz.say: If you see a zebra crossing, what should you do?

options.show: Wait for the signal or adult
options.say: Wait for the signal or adult

quiz.why: Even at a zebra crossing, you must wait for it to be safe.

wrong.1: Running is unsafe because you might trip or be seen suddenly.
wrong.2: You must wait for the right moment, not just walk when you want.
wrong.3: You must look in all directions, not just one way.

quiz.say: What is the best way to cross the road?

options.show: Cross when the road is empty
options.say: Cross when the road is empty

quiz.why: This sequence covers all the safety checks needed for crossing.

wrong.0: You must use the proper crossing spots, even if it looks empty.
wrong.2: Stopping must happen before you look or listen.
wrong.3: Running is never safe, even with an adult.
